entries.zh: 搅扰；以劳作搅扰其身，使不得安宁
entries.en: to disturb, to bother; to unquiet the body with labors

entries.zh: 寝食不安；忧心忡忡，寝食俱废
entries.en: to be restless with worry, unable to eat or sleep in peace
entries.notes: 西栏标[残]，仅据汉字“寝食不安”与闽南音 chin sit pur an 互证释义

entries.zh: 佐人；助人、帮衬他人（词头 inquirir“探问”与汉字之义不甚相合）
entries.en: to assist a person; the Chinese gloss sits oddly against headword inquirir "to inquire"
entries.notes: 汉字“佐人”与词头 inquirir 语义衔接不明，闽南音 cho lang 仅证读音

entries.zh: 错冒；错谬、冒失出错（冐为“冒”古体）
entries.en: to err, to blunder; to mistake rashly
entries.notes: 西栏[空]，“错冐”非通行复合词，释义据 冐＝冒 推断

entries.zh: 審打；审讯拷问、查审追究
entries.en: to examine and interrogate; to inquire by questioning
entries.notes: 西栏标[残]，可辨 Ynquirir: preguntar，汉字审打与闽南音 sim char 互证

entries.zh: 打（听）；暗中探问、打听底细
entries.en: to inquire secretly; to pry about
entries.notes: M 栏双读 fa / fa teng（＝打听）；R 栏 “idz.” 未详，“tam fia” 推为“探访”对音

entries.zh: 訪；访问、查访探问（复音另有 訪求 等读）
entries.en: to inquire, to ask about; to seek out (訪)
entries.notes: R 栏后半 “buyan” 未详，仅据 kong sim / kong chue 参证

entries.zh: 格；格物穷理之“格”，推究深察
entries.en: to investigate thoroughly, to scrutinize (as in 格物 gewu); to pursue

entries.zh: 訊察；讯问考察
entries.en: to interrogate and examine

entries.zh: 追究；追查究问，穷究根底
entries.en: to investigate to the bottom, to track down

entries.zh: 審奩；细审详察（第二字“奩”于此义生僻，或为异体/讹字，义依词头）
entries.en: to examine closely, to inquire into
entries.notes: 汉字第二字与闽南音 sit 不相应，读“审悉/审识”仅属推断

entries.zh: 審問；审问、讯问（问案）
entries.en: to interrogate, to question

entries.zh: 探听；私下探问消息、刺探
entries.en: to pry, to sound out secretly
entries.notes: M 栏多出 “abrigur so.” 字样，未详何义

entries.zh: 採訪；采访、采询查访
entries.en: to gather information, to inquire about

entries.zh: 訪求；访求探访，四处求问
entries.en: to seek out, to inquire after

entries.zh: 徵訪；征访、征询探访以求隐秘
entries.en: to inquire into secrets; to consult and inquire

entries.zh: 採訪；采访探询（秘密之事）
entries.en: to inquire into secrets by gathering information

entries.zh: 打探；打探消息底细
entries.en: to pry into, to seek out secrets

entries.zh: 探尋；探寻访求
entries.en: to search out, to inquire after

entries.zh: 考察；考察查验（西语残句涉 residencia，疑指任满离任审查之查考）
entries.en: to investigate, to examine (in the manner of a residencia review)
entries.notes: 西栏 “[por manera] de [residen]cia” 为封存件所记推测补全

entries.zh: 訪尋；访寻寻访，遍求探问
entries.en: to seek out, to inquire searching for

entries.zh: 打听；打听（隐秘之事）
entries.en: to inquire into secrets, to ask around
